annotations.title: Web Search Premier — deeper retrieval and reranking

description:
Search the live web with deeper retrieval and more careful reranking than `search`, and return ranked results (title, url, snippet). It reaches more sources — niche and long-tail pages included — and ranks the page that actually holds the answer higher. It takes the same parameters as `search` — `highlight`, `full_content`, the domain / text / language filters, the time window, `result_type` — and returns the same result shape.

USE FOR a lookup where finding the exact page decides the answer: a specific fact buried deep in a page, a niche document, a report or filing you can name but not locate — or a question `search` has just answered thinly or off-target. It takes longer than `search` and is billed separately at its own per-call rate, which a Search Plan's unlimited searches do not cover. So default to `search` for ordinary lookups, and reach for this one when ranking quality is what is missing. News still belongs in `news_search`, a company or a person in `business_search`, and a question spanning several independent subtopics in `broad_search`.

keywords: premier search, deeper search, higher accuracy, rerank, exact page, specific fact, hard to find, niche, long-tail, report, filing, document

count.description: Number of results to return (1-100). Default 5.

end_time.description: Upper bound for the time window, ISO 8601.

exclude_domains.description: Drop results from these domains. Max 1200, each ≤60 chars.

exclude_text.description: Drop results whose content contains any of these strings. Max 5, each ≤30 chars.

format.description: Format of returned content. Default text.

full_content.description: Return the cleaned full page body per result. Heavier than `highlight` — use only when the snippet isn't enough. Omit to use the server default (off).

max_tokens.description: Max tokens of full content per result (100-100000).

highlight.description: Return a ranked highlighted snippet per result. Omit to use the server default.

include_domains.description: Only return results from these domains (e.g. 'arxiv.org'). Max 1200, each ≤60 chars.

include_images.description: Return image URLs (and a cover image) found on each result page.

include_text.description: Only return results whose content contains all of these strings. Max 5, each ≤30 chars.

language.description: Languages to filter results by, as ISO 639-1 codes. Empty = no filter.

result_type.description: How results are returned. `standard` returns them as the other parameters specify; `dynamic` returns only the relevant ones — up to `count` — and adjusts highlight length per result. Default standard.

start_time.description: Lower bound for the time window, ISO 8601 (e.g. '2025-01-01T00:00:00Z').

time_basis.description: Which timestamp the time window filters against: page `published` date, last `crawled` date, or `auto`. Default auto.

time_range.description: Relative time window (e.g. `week`, `month`). Mutually exclusive with `start_time`/`end_time` — if both are given, the absolute range wins.

timeout.description: Request timeout in seconds (1-60). Defaults to 30s if unset.
